definitions.explanation: Describes a pleasantly chewy or bouncy texture, often used for rice, bread, or skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧もちもち⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: This bread is chewy and delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もちもち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧。
もちもち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たまらない→たまらない：03409_tamaranai⟧。
examples.english: I can't resist the chewy texture.

notes:
A ⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧ (mimetic word) derived from ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧ (mochi rice cake). Describes a pleasantly soft, elastic, chewy texture — the kind that bounces back when pressed. Always positive.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- もちもち⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be chewy/springy)
- もちもち⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧〜 (chewy ~)
- もちもち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (chewy ~, na-adjective usage)
- もちもち⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧ (chewy texture)

FOODS OFTEN DESCRIBED AS もちもち:
- ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧ (mochi rice cake)
- ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧ (udon noodles)
- ⟦タピオカ→タピオカ：05604_tapioka⟧ (tapioca pearls)
- ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧ (bread — especially soft, dense types)
- ⟦もち{米|ごめ}→もち米：10664_mochigome⟧ (glutinous rice)

BEYOND FOOD:
- もちもち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: soft, supple skin (compliment for smooth, bouncy skin)

SIMILAR TEXTURE WORDS:
- ⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧: fluffy, soft (lighter, airy)
- ⟦ぷりぷり→ぷりぷり：04826_puripuri⟧: firm and springy (for shrimp, fish)
- ⟦ねばねば→ねばねば：05258_nebaneba⟧: sticky, gooey (less positive connotation)
